comment: Resource budgets, see docs/adr/0011-lean-by-default.md. Raise a budget only in a PR that explains why. Baselines measured 2026-11-11 on commit d99655e. Initial JS lowered to 90 KB with lazy widgets, pages and catalogues (#116; measured 33.3 KB on 2026-11-12). Binary raised to 18.9 MB for the briefing, countdown and focus modules (#52, #54, #58; measured 18.0 MB on 2026-11-12). Image raised to 8.8 MB to match the binary budget (image is about 0.46 x the binary; measured 8.56 MB on 2026-11-13 after #183, #198). Binary raised to 19.5 MB and image to 9.0 MB for the immich, fuel, releases, game deals and habits modules (#184, #186, #187, #188, #190; measured 19.0 MB and 8.71 MB on 2026-11-13, roughly 0.2 MB per module). Binary raised to 20.0 MB and image to 9.3 MB for the mail, birthdays and photo frame modules (#283, #287, #286; main measured 19.3 MB on 2026-11-14 before mail; photo frame adds about 0.35 MB for the GIF decoder and JPEG encoder of the standard library). Binary raised to 20.5 MB and image to 9.5 MB for config as code (#88): go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 adds about 0.2 MB; main measured 19.7 MB and 9.2 MB on 2026-11-14. Binary raised to 21.0 MB and image to 9.8 MB for the wiki search module (#321) after calendar accounts (#282) and Slack/Teams channels (#324, #325) reached 20.5 MB and 9.5 MB on 2026-11-15; a size review is tracked in #358. piImageMB measured 2026-11-12 in the Raspberry Pi image workflow. extensionZipKB added for the local mode of the browser extension (ADR 0019, #291): measured 522 KB on 2026-11-15 with the app bundle, budget = measured + 10 %. Binary raised to 21.2 MB and image to 9.9 MB for the phone list module (#300) under the per-module allowance of ADR 0011; measured 21.1 MB on 2026-11-16.
